meta.title: Snap2Link · paste screenshots into Claude Code, Cursor, or any terminal AI
meta.description: Hotkey, drag a region, and a public share link lands in your clipboard. One keystroke, on Windows, macOS and Linux. Free, open source, MIT licensed.
hero.title: Paste screenshots into Claude Code, Cursor, or any terminal AI.
hero.lead: Hotkey, drag a region, and a public share link lands in your clipboard. One keystroke, on Windows, macOS and Linux. On Android, take a screenshot, tap Share, then Snap2Link: the link is copied.

why.title: Stop screenshotting, uploading, copying, pasting.
why.p1: You're working with Claude Code on a remote VPS. You need to show the model a UI bug, a design mockup, a stack trace. The usual workflow (screenshot, open the browser, upload somewhere, copy the URL, paste) is six steps, three apps, and a dozen seconds you'll never get back.
why.p2: Snap2Link collapses it into one keystroke. By default the capture goes to Snap2Link hosting: no account needed, and the link expires on its own. A free account keeps links for 48 hours and lets you lock the ones that matter. Prefer your own storage? Send captures to your Google Drive instead. No telemetry either way, and the link is on your clipboard before the toast finishes.
inbox.eyebrow: For the people who receive them
inbox.title: See the screenshot. Keep nothing.
inbox.lead: Developers, support teams and designers get screenshots all day from clients and colleagues. Each one lands in the phone's gallery, the Downloads folder or the chat, and stays there long after the bug is fixed. A Snap2Link capture arrives as a link instead: open it, read it, done.
inbox.nothing.title: Nothing saved on your device
inbox.nothing.body: The link opens in the browser. No file in your gallery, your Downloads or your chat's storage.
inbox.devices.title: Any device, same link
inbox.devices.body: The capture lives in the cloud, so the same link opens on your phone, your laptop or a colleague's screen. WhatsApp, X and LinkedIn even show a preview.
inbox.expires.title: Gone when you're done
inbox.expires.body: Links expire on their own after 24 hours, or 48 with a free account. Keep the ones you still need.
inbox.note: Only the sender needs Snap2Link. Send your clients to snap2link.app: it's free.

features.title: Built for the keystroke, not the tour.
features.ai.title: Built for AI workflows
features.ai.body: Pastes as a plain URL into any text field: Claude Code, Cursor, Aider, ChatGPT, Zed. Over SSH, Claude Code and opencode read the image itself through the Snap2Link MCP server.
features.capture.title: Region, screen or window
features.capture.body: Drag a region with live pixel dimensions, take the whole screen, or pick a window. Esc to cancel.
features.instant.title: Instant share link
features.instant.body: Under one second from drag-end to clipboard. Faster than your editor's auto-save.
features.shortcuts.title: Up to 3 shortcuts
features.shortcuts.body: Default Ctrl + PrtSc. Give each shortcut its own capture mode and next step: share at once, or annotate first.
features.platforms.title: Windows, macOS, Linux, Android
features.platforms.body: In 20 languages. Small installers: {sizes}. No Electron.
features.platforms.bodyNoSizes: In 20 languages. Small native installers, no Electron.
features.annotator.title: In-app annotator
features.annotator.body: Pen, rectangle, circle, arrow, text, blur. Six tools, one keystroke each. Opens in a separate window so you can keep typing in the terminal while you mark up.
features.history.title: History and kept links
features.history.body: Every link with its thumbnail and time left, in the app and on your account page. Copy it, delete it, or lock it so a new capture won't replace it.
features.updater.title: Built-in auto-updater
features.updater.body: Signed update archives, so every update verifies itself. Check for updates in Settings any time.
features.host.title: Your choice of host
features.host.body: Snap2Link hosting, where links expire on their own, or your own Google Drive with the drive.file scope: Snap2Link only sees what it created, and old captures go after 30 days by default.
how.title: Three steps. One keystroke each.
how.s1.title: Press the shortcut
how.s1.body: Default {shortcut}. Change it, or add up to 3 shortcuts, in Settings.
how.s2.title: Drag a region
how.s2.body: The screen dims. Drag any rectangle. Annotate with arrows, boxes, or blur a sensitive zone, or skip and ship.
how.s3.title: Paste anywhere
how.s3.body: The link is on your clipboard. Paste it into Claude Code, Cursor, a chat, an issue. Anything that takes an image URL.
install.title: On your computer and on Android.
install.winCommand: Prefer the terminal? Install with winget:
install.androidNote: On Android, take a screenshot, tap Share, then Snap2Link: the link is copied. Open the downloaded file on your phone and allow the install when Android asks. The app isn't on the Play Store yet.
install.macNote: The app isn't notarised by Apple yet, so macOS blocks the first launch. Open it once and close the warning, then go to System Settings, Privacy & Security, and click Open Anyway next to Snap2Link.
install.signing: Windows installers aren't code-signed yet, so SmartScreen may ask you to confirm.
open.title: Free, open source, MIT licensed.
open.lead: Read the source, file an issue, ship a PR. Early days: every star helps.
open.source.title: Read the source
open.source.body: Tauri v2 and Rust for the app, React and TypeScript for the interface, a Cloudflare Worker for the hosting.
open.contribute.title: Contribute
open.contribute.body: First-issue PRs welcome. Every PR runs the Vitest, cargo test and hosting tests. Reviews are friendly.
footer.tag: Screenshot, public link, clipboard. One keystroke.
